proposal_rule: cup/mug bbox-bottom center inside desk bbox; absolute median predicted-depth gap <=0.75 m; one closest-depth parent per child
annotation_rule: Use RGB image and 2D boxes only. Positive when paired cup/mug visibly rests on paired desk; negative when clearly elsewhere; null if ambiguous. Do not view depth or 3D reference before labels are saved.
evaluation: Candidate-pair TP/TN/FP/FN, excluding null labels. No threshold tuning or code edits after labels.
caveat: Ten selected scenes, one annotator, official oracle 2D boxes and intrinsics. Metadata-index spacing reduces immediate neighbors but does not prove room independence.
